outcome: Rate of grade 3 or worse postoperative complications
cohort: The study included 289 consecutive patients with a history of previous cesarean section who underwent either vaginal or laparoscopic hysterectomy.
finding: Laparoscopic hysterectomy (LH) is a safe and feasible procedure in patients with previous CS, associated with a low bladder injury rate and a shorter length of hospital stay compared to vaginal hysterectomy (VH).
mod_finding: A history of two or more previous cesarean sections significantly increased the risk of developing bladder injuries during hysterectomy.
